categories.name: kernel
categories.evidence: Modifies the C kernel API functions `btck_transaction_create` and `btck_block_create` in `src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp` and `bitcoinkernel.h`.
categories.rationale: Prevents silent deserialization of malformed or mismatched input buffers by returning null when unconsumed trailing bytes remain. Correctness at the boundary is an explicit priority for the kernel API, though this specific validation tightening is reasonably deferrable.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Despite the Validation label, this PR solely alters libbitcoinkernel C API functions and tests without touching node consensus rules or validation internals.
categories.rationale: Kernel API wrappers are explicitly excluded from the validation category when they do not alter validation logic.
